notes.title: v1.04!
notes.notes:
v1.04
- Full controller support fixes (unlocking, item selection, item use, etc.) Should be fully fixed.
- Fix controller config menu.
- Add resyncing achievements on title screen.
- Upgraded to Unity 5 (oh boy)
- Various optimizations and bugfixes

Still a little bit more to go that I'm working on right now, but, now those who have a Steambox or use Big Picture have no need to use a mouse at all now! (sans er, configuring initially).

notes.title: v1.03
notes.notes:
v1.03
- Fix sorting issues.
- Fix controller support on multiple screens (options, controller config, etc.)
- Fix additional item effects making grid stick after use.
- Fix selection in arena mode with controller and mouse.
- Fix multiplayer selection support.
- Fix quests not progressing properly.
- Fix not being able to select auto button with controller (finally).
- Various small bugfixes.

As usual, please report any additional bugs you might find to dotwarriorgames@gmail.com. We do read all of your emails and take all of your feedback to heart. You guys have all been really awesome!

notes.title: v1.02 is live!
notes.notes:
v1.02
- Fix character unlocking not working correctly (star block scale calculation)
- Fix quitting and resuming not saving battle state.
- Fix customization UI for items and starblock counts.
- Fix block clearing items (row, column, cross, blockscalibur) from not refilling screen again.
- Fix layering on cursor in NPC screen.
- Fix item effects occasionally softlocking on screen.

I apologize as I've been out of it as I've been at GDC this week, but trying to code as much as possible in between meetings and in transit. I apologize as I've been battling 14hr time difference jetlag, biz dev nonsense, rushing around to various meetings, and coding in between. Also, I feel sorry for apologizing all the time without following through. I know the feeling as I've been flying United with tons of delays and they've also been apologizing to me without following through *rimshot*, or maybe this is my punishment for not fixing bugs huh...anyway ENJOY! More to come soon, working on the quests as well but since there's so many of them I'm testing them thoroughly to make sure I didn't miss anything.

notes.title: v1.01
notes.notes:
Changelist:
- Fix items.
- Adjust quests.
- Minor bugfixes all around.

This build is mostly a hotfix for the items. I incredibly apologize for these bad bugs. To be honest, "We" is actually just an "I", so if anything I only have myself to blame for these things to slip through the cracks. To everyone who's bought and enjoyed the game so far I appreciate all the support. I'm a little upset with myself that you were not able to enjoy the game as intended.

That said, I have been working to get these issues sorted out as soon as possible and have been reading all your feedback good and bad. However, for the fastest way to reach me is as always dotwarriorgames@gmail.com. Happy block breaking guys.
